Russ Roberts [interviews](http://www.econtalk.org/archives/2007/04/bogle_on_invest.html "interviews") Vanguard founder John Bogle on his book, [The Little Book of Common Sense Investing: The Only Way to Guarantee Your Fair Share of Stock Market Returns (Little Book Big Profits)](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/0470102101/104-9448699-9787948?ie=UTF8&tag=institutional-20&linkCode=xm2&camp=1789&creativeASIN=0470102101 "The Little Book of Common Sense Investing: The Only Way to Guarantee Your Fair Share of Stock Market Returns (Little Book Big Profits)").
